candidates.decision_relevance: Would establish whether weakness in price, relative performance, and other cited indicators preceded or followed drawdowns and rebounds, helping distinguish persistent deterioration from a short-lived move without relying on weekly endpoints.
candidates.evidence_reference: Weekly reviews W37–W46 and daily outputs Nov 15–17, 2026: repeated requests for raw price paths, timestamp-aligned signal sequences, and point-in-time observations.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped hourly BTC and ETH prices and available cited indicators
candidates.missing_history_problem: The reviews generally provide aggregate returns or qualitative path descriptions, not a consistently aligned hourly history of the cited observations. This prevents sequence and lead-lag assessment and makes retrospective use of completed-week evidence difficult to separate from issuance-time evidence.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would make changes in participation assessable on a consistent universe and help test whether reported breadth shifts reflect broad participation or changing asset membership.
candidates.evidence_reference: Daily outputs Nov 15–17, 2026: top-100 proxy breadth membership changed between captures; canonical breadth was unconfirmed. Weekly reviews also cite missing breadth history and methodology.
candidates.metric_name: Constituent-level daily returns with dated universe membership
candidates.missing_history_problem: Available breadth is described as proxy or point-in-time, with changing membership and limited history. Aggregate advancer counts cannot establish whether participation broadened or narrowed on a like-for-like basis.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would show whether ETF flow direction and BTC/ETH divergence persisted or changed across the periods under review, rather than relying on stale latest-settled rows or isolated weekly totals.
candidates.evidence_reference: Weekly reviews W44–W46 note flow detail is stale or absent for the reviewed week; daily outputs Nov 15–17 report latest settled rows dated Nov 13 and unavailable intervening sessions.
candidates.metric_name: Dated settled ETF flow rows by asset and reported unit
candidates.missing_history_problem: The supplied analyses repeatedly lack a current, continuous settled-flow sequence aligned to the price and breadth observations. Stale or isolated rows cannot establish persistence, within-period changes, or whether the two assets’ flows diverged over time.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would allow retrospective evaluation of forecast ranges and warning hypotheses against only the information available at issuance, and distinguish matured candidate-linked outcomes from unlinked aggregate counts.
candidates.evidence_reference: Weekly reviews W34–W46 repeatedly report missing candidate bounds, issue times, point-in-time feature snapshots, and candidate-linked outcome rows; daily outputs include unratified candidates but not a complete longitudinal audit trail.
candidates.metric_name: Frozen forecast candidate specifications, issuance-time evidence references, and linked matured outcome records
candidates.missing_history_problem: Candidate counts and aggregate matured-outcome counts do not reveal what was specified or known at each freeze, nor which realized paths belong to each candidate. Without those records, range precision, hindsight leakage, and candidate-specific outcomes cannot be checked.
